title: The Property Facility Fee on a Hotel Rate Plans Cancellation Settlement
content:
The share of the facility element returned on a cancellation settlement against a Hotel Rate Plans reservation turns on whether the rate plan booked waives the property facility fee and on whether such a fee has in fact been posted.

## The rule

1. Where the rate plan booked does not waive the property facility fee and a property facility fee has been posted on the reservation, 0 percent of the facility element is returned.
2. Where the rate plan booked waives the property facility fee and a property facility fee has nonetheless been posted on the reservation, 100 percent of the facility element is returned.
3. In every other case 100 percent of the facility element is returned.

The facility element is the property facility fee posted on the reservation. A facility fee has been posted when facility fee lines stand on the folio for more than nothing.

## Which plans waive the fee

| Rate plan | Property facility fee waived |
| --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | no |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | no |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | no |
| Standard Flexible Rate | no |
| Member Flex Rate | no |
| Suite Flexible Rate | no |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | yes |

## The combinations

| Plan waives the facility fee | A facility fee stands on the folio | Share of the facility element returned |
| --- | --- | --- |
| no | yes | 0 percent |
| yes | yes | 100 percent |
| no | no | 100 percent |
| yes | no | 100 percent |

Where nothing has been posted, the share is 100 percent of nothing, which is nothing.

## Worked on hypothetical figures

A facility element of 140.00 USD posted on the reservation:

- On the Suite Flexible Rate, which does not waive the fee, 0 percent is returned, which is 0.00 USD.
- On the All-Inclusive Flex Rate, which waives it and yet carries the posted fee, 100 percent is returned, which is 140.00 USD.
- Where no facility fee had been posted at all, the returned figure on either plan would be 100 percent of 0.00 USD, which is 0.00 USD.
